for name,pin in pins.items():assert h(source/name)==pin
data=json.loads(facts.read_text())
assert data['actualFormattedReplaySha256']=='5d800923b60c64ecf086a522223254877f23a78cd9abd3fd18fc0275f2c1d5a8'
assert data['clientSha256']=='072ce61b3c0f94d94076ef18c7acd170a4331e53d0968a132c08c85f15628c9c'
assert data['actualFinalGlobalSourceDigest']=='a1f8e1c0eaf02f16834f6c129a2749411ab1bd5462f4daf501dc5182f6ff0ebc'
assert data['actualFinalDistDigest']=='e19da60efb0a7f5eb1563a932b5b3d69f3c701e0b73e5155726e71970bae30c1'
assert data['actualFinalImageContentId']=='sha256:bd83d49256b5be0d2c8dc60b26ec92bef0bcf063eaa0a49de3d0db1fd154e753'
for key in ['sourceBindingReviewReference','finalConfiguredBuildReceipt','finalImagePinsQaReference','finalDeployment722QaReference','finalD2QaReference']:
